title: Language locale and culture reference
reason:
Provisional Phase 1 concept only. Fresh Phase 2 must decide existing-meaning reuse, equivalence and distinctions. It is not a canonical definition or accepted source mapping.

Phase 2 UNRESOLVED: Work, edition, media item, file, codec, Internet media type, genre and language are distinct. Local publication/track/film IDs are source-scoped; no inferred ISBN/DOI identity. Language is distinct from locale/tag and formatting culture. Compound composer/actor strings require a reviewed multiplicity policy; padding/legacy locale aliases require raw-preserving bridges. Definition gap: the candidate combines source roles or lacks a sufficiently bounded reusable definition and binding domain. Retain the candidate; do not infer absence from literal query results.
